title: Cable Jointing Field Guide Pakistan 2026 — 11kV & LT XLPE Heat Shrink / Cold Shrink Step-by-Step Installation, DISCO Compliance & QA/QC Dossier
summary_html: Pakistan's first complete cable jointing field guide: step-by-step 11kV and LT XLPE joint installation procedures, heat shrink vs cold shrink selection matrix for Pakistan climate, DISCO-approved jointer qualification requirements (LESCO, K-Electric, FESCO, IESCO 2026), mandatory pre- and post-jointing tests (VLF, megger, tan-delta), screen bonding and link box guidance, XLPE-to-PILC transition jointing rules, site toolkit checklist with prices, joint failure mode ranking with Pakistan utility data, and the complete QA/QC dossier format for DISCO completion certificates. Covers LT armoured cable step-by-step and 11kV cold shrink simplified step-by-step procedures.
cluster: LT/MV Power Cable — Day 3 (D82=LT Cable, D83=MV Accessories, D84=Jointing Field Guide)
